y-m-81-05.title: Zvidimbu zvemashoko eHangul zvingani zvisina final consonant?
y-m-81-05.goal: Siyanisa ratio yemichimiro inogoneka neratio inoshandiswa chaizvo mukunyora chaiko, uye utaure kuti ruzivo nenzira dzipi dzinodiwa kuwana yekupedzisira.
y-m-81-05.material: Chidimbu chimwe cheHangul yazvino chinogadzirwa neinitial consonant, medial vowel, uye, kana iripo, final consonant (batchim). Chibvumirano chebasa iri: verenga sarudzo 19 dzeinitial consonant, 21 dzevowel, uye 28 dzefinal consonant, kusanganisira 'hapana final consonant.' Kufungidzira: chero initial, vowel nefinal zvinogona kubatanidzwa nemahara, uye tinoverenga michimiro inogona kugadzirwa. Hatifungi kana zvidimbu izvozvo zvichishandiswa chaizvo.
y-m-81-05.thinking.1: Kusiyanisa nyaya dzinogoneka nekuti dzinoshandiswa kangani chaizvo
y-m-81-05.prereq.2: Kugona kuverenga mazita emavara eHangul (tsananguro yekuti chidimbu chinogadzirwa neinitial, vowel nefinal iri mumaterials)
y-m-81-05.s.s1.prompt: Fungidzira. Pakati pemichimiro yose inogona kugadzirwa, inenge chikamu chipi ndezvidimbu zvisina final consonant?
y-m-81-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora nhamba yezvidimbu zvose zvisina final consonant nezvose zvine final consonant, imwe neimwe nemitaurire yenhamba dzeinitials, vowels nefinals.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kana uchiwana ratio yenhamba mbiri, tarisa zvinoitika kunhamba dzeinitials nevowels.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.a: Wakaenzanisa nhamba yenyaya dzisina final consonant nenhamba yenyaya dzose. Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti nhamba dzeinitial consonants nevowels dzinopinda zvakaenzana mumativi ose maviri.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.b: Kusava nefinal consonant ndi1 pamafinal consonants 28 anogoneka. Verenga zvakare kuti 1 pa28 ndechikamu chipi chehuwandu hwose.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.c: Kuona mugove we "hapana final consonant" pakati pesarudzo dzefinal consonant 28 sechikamu chimwe chesere kukuru zvakanyanya. Initial consonant nevowel zvinowanzwa zvakaenzana munyaya dzose.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.d: Zvinoita sewakapatsanura chete kuita zviviri, "ine final consonant" ne "haina", ukazviona sehafu nehafu. Nyaya ine final consonant inopatsanuka kuita sarudzo 27.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.explain: Zvidimbu zvisina final zvinoita 19×21=399, uye huwandu hwose i19×21×28=11172. Ratio i399÷11172=1/28≈3.6%. Nhamba dzeinitials nevowels dzinowanzwa nenzira imwe chete kunyange kana pane final kana kwete, saka ratio inova 1 pa28 yemafinals.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.prompt: Kuona ratio yakawanikwa pamusoro, mudzidzi akati, "Saka mukunyora chaiko futi, mavara asina final consonant achaoneka neratio iyoyo chete." Chii chakaitwa kuchirevo ichi?
y-m-81-05.s.s2.hint.0: Fungidzira kana 'nhamba yemichimiro inogoneka' ne 'nhamba yenguva dzinoonekwa mukunyora' zvichiri chinhu chimwe chete.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti mhedziso ingava ipi kana chidimbu chega chega chikaonekwa kakafanana, uye kana kufungidzira uku kuchizova kwechokwadi.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.a: Kwete. Asi kana zvinyorwa zvikava zvakareba zvikuru, zvinosvika padhuze ne3.6% pachazvo.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.a: Kukosha kunogadzikana sezvo zvinyorwa zvichireba iratio inoshandiswa mukunyora. Haiendi kuratio yenhamba yemichimiro inogoneka.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.b: Hazvigoni kuziva. Ruzivo rwekuti pane marudzi 28 emafinal consonants rungaita rwakaipa.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.b: 28 ndicho chibvumirano chebasa iri. Dambudziko hariri nhamba yakabvumirwa asi kana ratio yenhamba ichigona kushandurwa kuita kakawanda kekushandisa.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.c: Kwete. Tinofanira kuziva kuti vara rega rega rinoshandiswa kangani mukunyora.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.c: Wakasiyanisa nhamba yemichimiro inogoneka nenhamba chaiyo yekushandisa. Wakaona kakawanda kekushandisa seruzivo rwunofanira kutsvakurudzwa wega.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.d: Hongu. Iratio pakati pemavara ose anogoneka, saka iratio imwe chete mukunyorawo.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.d: Ratio ye "michimiro inogoneka" neye "mavara anoshandiswa chaizvo" yakasiyana. Zvinoenderana nekuti vara rega rega rinoshandiswa kangani.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.explain: 11172 inhamba ye 'michimiro inogona kushandiswa.' Mukunyora chaiko, zvimwe zvidimbu zvinoshandiswa kazhinji uye zvimwe hazvishandiswi zvakanyanya. Pasina kufungidzira kwekuti michimiro yose inoshandiswa kakafanana, haugoni kushandura ratio yenhamba kuita ratio yekushandisa.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.prompt: Ungaziva sei ratio yezvidimbu zvisina final mukunyora chaiko? Nyora nzira nemuganhu mumwe kana kupfuura wenzira iyoyo.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza zvinyorwa zvimwe zvekuverenga uye ufungidzire nzira yekupatsanura zvidimbu zvazvo kuita mapoka maviri (hapana final / ine final).
y-m-81-05.s.s3.hint.1: Fungidzira kana mugumisiro uchigona kuvimbwa kana wakasarudza chinyorwa chimwe chete.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvose kuti unosarudza sei chinyorwa nemaitiro ekugadzira ratio kubva pamigumisiro yakaverengwa here?
y-m-81-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kana wakanyora muganhu, wakanongedza zvakananga 'zvisingakuudzi nenzira iyi' here?
y-m-81-05.s.s3.model.0: Sarudza chinyorwa chimwe, verenga zvidimbu zvisina final, uye ugovanise nehuwandu hwose hwezvidimbu kuwana ratio. Asi chinyorwa chimwe chinogona kutsamira kudivi rimwe nemukana, saka unofanira kuunganidza zvinyorwa zvakawanda uye uverenge nenzira imwe chete kuti uvimbe.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.model.1: Sarudza peji imwe yebhuku, verenga zvidimbu zvisina final nezvidimbu zvose, uye uwane ratio. Peji rimwe rinogona kusiyana nerudzi rwekunyora, saka unofanira kuunganidza uye kuenzanisa marudzi akawanda ekunyora, sendetemo nezvinyorwa zvekutsanangura.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ndakapa semuganhu kuti mugumisiro unoenderana nerudzi rwekunyora.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.model.2: Verenga mavara asina final consonant muchinyorwa chimwe uye uwane ratio. Chinyorwa chimwe chete chingatsamira kuhunhu hwechinyorwa icho.

y-m-81-02.title: Ngatigadzirei mutemo wegore rokuwedzera isu pachedu
y-m-81-02.goal: Nzwisisa kuti mutemo wegore rokuwedzera unosarudza hurefu hwepakati hwegore, gadzira mitemo yakati wandei inosangana namamiriro, uye uenzanise nokutsanangura hukuru hwokukanganisa kwayo.
y-m-81-02.material: Nguva yakatorwa neNyika kutenderera Zuva kamwe (tropical year) inenge mazuva 365.2422. Gore rekarenda ndi mazuva 365 kana mazuva 366 (gore rokuwedzera), saka tinofanira kusarudza kuti zuva rinowedzerwa makore mangani ega ega. Tinonyora mutemo se 'isa mazuva okuwedzera L mudenderedzwa remakore N,' uye gore repakati ndi mazuva 365+L÷N. Pfungwa: tora tropical year se mazuva 365.2422, uye uenzanise kuti karenda inotsvedzera zvakadini kubva pamwaka nomusiyano wemavhareji.
y-m-81-02.thinking.0: Kufungidzira kuti kutsvedzera kunounganidzwa kunokura zvakadini

Musoro we 'Math and Culture' unofungidzirwa kuti uchaedzwa nevadzidzi vakatodzidza masvomhu echikoro chepamusoro (nhamba, zvirevo, mabasa, nomukana wakareruka).

y-m-81-02.s.s1.prompt: Fungidzira kutanga. Kana ukashandisa gore rokuwedzera kamwe makore 4 ega ega (kuwedzera zuva rimwe makore 4 ega ega) uye ukaenderera, kurekanisa karenda kubva pamwaka kuchava kwakadini mushure memakore 1000?
y-m-81-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kumutemo wemakore 4, nyora hurefu hwepakati hwegore padivi pemazuva 365.2422 uye uzvienzanise.
y-m-81-02.s.s1.hint.1: Funga zvinoitika kana musiyano mudiki wegore rega rega unounganidzwa nguva 1000.
y-m-81-02.s.s1.r.a: Unogona kunge wakatora musiyano wegore rega rega sedikiti zvakanyanya, kana wakarasikirwa nenzvimbo yokukosha pakuwanza nehuwandu hwemakore.
y-m-81-02.s.s1.r.b: Wakatora musiyano wegore rega rega se nguva 10 huru zvakanyanya. Nyora zvakare musiyano pakati pehurefu hwepakati pasi pemutemo wemakore 4 nemazuva 365.2422.
y-m-81-02.s.s1.r.c: Wakayera hukuru nokuwanza musiyano mudiki unounganidzwa gore rega rega nehuwandu hwemakore.
y-m-81-02.s.s1.r.d: Kunyange nemakore okuwedzera, kana avhareji isina kuenzana chaizvo ne tropical year, musiyano unounganidzwa. Enzanisa mavhareji.
y-m-81-02.s.s1.explain: Avhareji yemutemo wemakore 4 ndi mazuva 365.25 uye tropical year inenge mazuva 365.2422, saka musiyano wemazuva 0.0078 unounganidzwa gore rega rega. Mushure memakore 1000 ndi mazuva anenge 7.8, saka anenge mazuva 8.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.prompt: Ikozvino gadzira mumwe iwe pachako. Kumutemo 'isa mazuva okuwedzera L mudenderedzwa remakore N,' gadzira mitemo 2 yakasiyana umo avhareji yegore (mazuva 365+L÷N) iri mukati memazuva 0.0005 emazuva 365.2422. (N inhamba yechisikigo kusvika pa 400, uye L inhamba yakazara ye 0 kana kupfuura.)
y-m-81-02.s.s2.hint.0: Mu avhareji 365+L÷N, L÷N inoda kuva padhuze ne 0.2422. Tanga wasarudza N, wobva wachinja L uye uenzanise L÷N.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.hint.1: Yedza kuti N diki kana N huru inoita kuti zvive nyore kuenzanisa kukanganisa mukati memhando inobvumirwa.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.ok.c1: N ne L inhamba dzizere mukati memamiriro.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.fail.c1: N inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 400, uye L inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara ye 0 kana kupfuura.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Gore repakati rinosiyana nemazuva 365.2422 nemazuva anopfuura 0.0005.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.explain: Mienzaniso: mazuva 8 mumakore 33 (avhareji inenge mazuva 365.2424), mazuva 31 mumakore 128 (avhareji mazuva 365.2421875), uye mazuva 97 mumakore 400 (avhareji mazuva 365.2425) ose anosangana namamiriro. Mitemo ine reshiyo imwe chete L÷N (semuenzaniso mazuva 8 mumakore 33 nemazuva 16 mumakore 66) inoverengwa semutemo mumwe chete. Pane mimwe mitemo mizhinji inosangana namamiriro.

y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.ask: Unofunga chii nezveyut ne mo mushure mekuona data iri?
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.after: Mukana wekuwana 60 kana kupfuura pa100 kana p=1/2 inenge 3%. Haujairiki, asi hausi nezvisingagoneki, saka kunyange kana ukafunga kuti p yakakura kupfuura 0.5 kana kuchengeta kutonga kwako kwekutanga, zvinonzwisisika chero bedzi uchitaura humbowo hwako. Kana p=0.6, yut inenge 0.130 uye mo inenge 0.026, saka yut ine mukana unenge 5 nguva.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.a: Yaiva 60, saka tinogona kugadzika p=0.6, uye tinogona kutaura kuti yut inouya inenge 5 nguva kupfuura mo.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Kukanda kwe100 haisi nhamba huru. 0.6 kufungidzira, kwete kukosha kwakagadzikwa, uye inogona kuva 0.55 kana 0.65.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.b: p ingava padhuze ne0.6, saka yut inogona kuuya kazhinji kupfuura mo. Asi ngwarira nezve kuti kazhinji zvakadini.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Wakataurawo kusava nechokwadi mukufungidzira. Kutonga kwako kunobatanidza huwandu hwedata nekuvimba kwako.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Dumbu rakauya nguva 60 nemusana nguva 40, saka ratio yeyut ne mo i60:40 futi, inenge 1.5 nguva.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Kuti yut ive, zvinhonga zvose zvina zvinofanira kuratidza dumbu, saka ndi p yakawanzwa kana. Haugoni kushandisa ratio yechinhonga chimwe sezvakaita.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.d: 60 pa100 inogona kuitika nemukana, saka kuchine chikonzero chidiki chekurasa kutonga kwekutanga kwekuti p=1/2.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.d: Wakafunga chiyero chinotsanangurwa nemukana ukachengeta kutonga kwako kwekutanga. Unogonawo kufunga kuti kubva kupi kubva pachiyero icho zvinova zvakaoma kuzvidaidza kuti mukana.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.info: Zvinhonga zvina zvakasiyana pakati pazvo: zvinhonga zviviri zvine mukana wedumbu we0.6, uye zviviri zvimwe zvine mukana wedumbu we0.4 (zvinhonga hazvikanganisani).
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.after: Yut i0.6×0.6×0.4×0.4=0.0576 uye mo i0.4×0.4×0.6×0.6=0.0576, saka zvakaenzana. Kana p yezvinhonga zvose yakafanana, yut ne mo zvakaenzana chete kana p=1/2, asi kana chinhonga chega chega chakasiyana, zvinogona kuenzana nenzira iyi nemukana.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Yut inouya kazhinji, nokuti zvimwe zvinhonga zvine mukana wedumbu we0.6.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Pane zvinhonga ne0.6, asi pane zvinhonga ne0.4 futi. Nyora mikana yeyut ne mo imwe neimwe semugumisiro uye uvaenzanise.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Haigoni kusarudzwa kubva pamamiriro ekuti zvinhonga hazvikanganisani oga.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Nemamiriro 'havakanganisani,' unogona kuwanza mikana. Ongorora zvakare kana makosha aunoda atopiwa.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Mo inouya kazhinji, nokuti zvimwe zvinhonga zvine mukana wedumbu wakaderera.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Kune mo, unofanirawo kufunga kuti chinhonga chine 0.6 chinowira pamusana nemukana we0.4.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.d: Zvakaenzana. Yut i0.6×0.6×0.4×0.4 uye mo i0.4×0.4×0.6×0.6, saka mugumisiro wakafanana.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.d: Wakaenzanisa yut ne mo nekunyora imwe neimwe semugumisiro. Wakacherekedza kuti nhamba dzakafanana dzinoshandiswa muzvose, nezvinhonga zvichiratidza dumbu padivi rimwe nemusana kune rimwe.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.reflect: Kutonga kwako kana p=1/2 kwakachinja sei mushure medata rekukanda kwe100 nemushure mekudzidza kuti p inosiyana nechinhonga nechinhonga? Taura kana ruzivo rutsva rwakachinja kutonga kwako kana kuti rwakachinja kuvimba kwako.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.prompt: Kuti utaure 'yut ne mo zvakaenzana mukana,' ruzivo rupi rumwe runodiwa, uye ungaenzanisa sei kana waruwana? Runyore.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora padivi nedivi kuti chinhonga chega chega chinofanira kuwira sei kune yut uye kune mo.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti makosha api aunofanira kuziva kuenzanisa zvose nenhamba.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ruzivo rwawakanyora rwunoshandiswa chaizvo kuverenga mukana weyut nemukana we mo here?
y-m-81-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakasiyanisa 'kana p dzose dzakafanana' ne 'kana chinhonga chega chega chakasiyana' here?
y-m-81-03.s.s3.model.0: Unofanira kuziva mukana p wekuti chinhonga chega chega chiwire dumbu rakatarisa kumusoro. Kana zvinhonga zvose zvina zvine p imwe chete, yut ne mo zvakaenzana chete kana p=1/2; kana chinhonga chega chega chakasiyana, unofanira kuenzanisa mugumisiro wemikana yedumbu yechinhonga chega chega nemugumisiro wemikana yemusana.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.model.1: Unofanira kuziva mukana wechinhonga chega chega wekuwira dumbu rakatarisa kumusoro uye kana zvinhonga zvichikanganisana (kuzvimiririra). Nemakosha iwayo, wanza mikana yose yedumbu kune yut nemikana yose yemusana kune mo, uye uvaenzanise.

y-m-81-06.prereq.0: 'H3' mubasa iri chiratidzo chenhanho yokuoma nokutsigira yeboka rokugadzira iri chete. Hachireve kuti chidzidzo chipi nechipi chakapiwa kugiredhi rakati. Musoro we 'Math and Culture' unofungidzirwa kuti uchaedzwa nevadzidzi vakatodzidza masvomhu echikoro chepamusoro (nhamba, zvirevo, mabasa, nomukana wakareruka).
y-m-81-06.title: Kana vertex imwe ichishanda, pateni yose inoshanda here?
y-m-81-06.topic: Mapateni ematailosi epolygon akaenzana nekuzadza plane
y-m-81-06.goal: Wana misanganiswa yakawanda ine makona pavertex imwe anowedzera kuita 360°, uye utonge kuti mamiriro aya haakwani kuzadza plane yose.
y-m-81-06.material: Kana uchigadzira pateni, unobatanidza matayera epolygon akaenzana pasina nzvimbo dzisina chinhu kana kupindirana. Makona ematayera anosangana pavertex imwe anofanira kuwedzera kuita 360°. Hukuru hwekona imwe yepolygon yakaenzana ye n-gon hwunosarudzwa ne n (triangle yakaenzana 60°, square yakaenzana 90°, hexagon yakaenzana 120°). Mubasa iri tinotarisa nyaya umo mapolygon akaenzana matatu anosangana pavertex imwe chete, uye nhamba yemativi inhamba yechisikigo kubva pa3 kusvika pa50.
y-m-81-06.prereq.1: Hukuru hwekona yemukati yepolygon yakaenzana (geometry yechikoro chepakati), kugadzirisa mafraction nemaequation
y-m-81-06.prereq.2: Pfungwa yemapolygon akaenzana akakomberedza poinzi (makona anowedzera kuita kutenderera kwakazara)
y-m-81-06.s.s1.prompt: Fungidzira kutanga. Kunze kwemahexagon akaenzana matatu (6,6,6), ndeipi imwe misanganiswa yemapolygon akaenzana matatu pavertex imwe ine makona anowedzera kuita 360°? (N-gon ine mativi n, uye n i50 kana pasi.)
y-m-81-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kana pane triangle imwe yakaenzana (60°), fungidzira kuti huwandu hwemakona emapolygon mamwe maviri hunofanira kuva hupi.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.hint.1: Shandisa nzira imwe chete kana pane square imwe yakaenzana (90°), uye uwane misanganiswa mishoma.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.a: Mapolygon akaenzana asiri triangle, square, nehexagon (sa octagon yakaenzana) ane makonawo. Zvakadini kana ukaedza imwe kana maviri acho?
y-m-81-06.s.s1.o.b: Pane misanganiswa mishoma chete ine triangle yakaenzana.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.b: Ongororawo kana pane misanganiswa isina triangle yakaenzana. Zvakadini nehuwandu hune pentagon yakaenzana kana octagon yakaenzana?
y-m-81-06.s.s1.o.c: Kunze kwe (6,6,6), pane mimwe mishoma zvakare.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakasiya mukana wekuti mapolygon asiri maotriangle, masquare nemahexagon akaenzana anogona kushandiswa. Unogona kuedza zvakananga kuongorora nhamba.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.d: Zvakaoma kuwana chikonzero chekuti pane imwe chete zvakare. Verenga zvakananga kuti unogona kugadzira misanganiswa mingani nemapolygon asiri triangle, square nehexagon yakaenzana.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.explain: Kana ukaitsvaga iwe amene munhanho inotevera, uchawana kuti pane misanganiswa 10 pamwe chete, kusanganisira (6,6,6).
y-m-81-06.s.s2.prompt: Wana uye uise misanganiswa 4 yakasiyana umo a-gon yakaenzana, b-gon yakaenzana, ne c-gon yakaenzana zvinosangana pavertex imwe uye makona anowedzera kuita 360° chaizvo. (3 ≤ a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ 50, zvose nhamba dzechisikigo. Verenga musanganiswa une kurongeka kwakasiyana semumwe chete.)
y-m-81-06.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzira tebhura yehukuru hwekona imwe ye n-gon yakaenzana uye unyore mashoma uchitanga pa3.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza a diki zvikuru, wana kuti huwandu hwemakona mamwe maviri hunofanira kuva hupi, wobva wachinja b.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba dzemativi dzinhamba dzechisikigo kubva pa3 kusvika pa50.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba dzemativi dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzechisikigo kubva pa3 kusvika pa50.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Ndapota dziise nenzira a ≤ b ≤ c.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.prompt: Tarisa (5,5,10) pakati pemisanganiswa yawakawana. Pavertex imwe, mapentagon akaenzana maviri nedecagon yakaenzana imwe anogona kuzadza 360°. Ipapo musanganiswa uyu woga unogona kugadzira pateni inozadza plane yose pasina nzvimbo dzisina chinhu here?
y-m-81-06.s.s3.hint.0: Dhirowa mavertex emichimiro iri padhuze nedivi rimwe redecagon yakaenzana uye uongorore kana musanganiswa mumwe chete uchienderera.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.hint.1: Kana mapentagon akaenzana maviri akasangana nedivi, ongorora kana vertex iri padhuze ichipawo musanganiswa mumwe chete.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.a: Poinzi imwe kuenderana hakukwani kuziva. Unofanira kuongorora wega kuti mavertex ari padhuze anoenderanawo.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.a: Wakaparadzanisa kuenderana papoinzi imwe nekuenderana kose kose. Wakarongedza kuti ndezvipi mamiriro anodiwa uye ndezvipi akakwana.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.b: Wega (4,6,12), musanganiswa unoshandisa marudzi ose matatu, ndiwo unogona kuzadza plane yose pasina nzvimbo dzisina chinhu.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.b: (6,6,6) ne (4,8,8) zvinewo mapateni anozadza plane yose. Nhamba yemarudzi haisi mwero.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.c: Makona pavertex imwe anowedzera zvakarurama, saka kuenderera nenzira imwe chete kunogara kuchizadza plane yose.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.c: Makona papoinzi imwe kuwedzera zvakarurama imamiriro anodiwa. Kana mavertex ari padhuze achishandawo nemusanganiswa mumwe chete nyaya yakasiyana.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.d: Nhamba yemisanganiswa inoshanda pavertex imwe inogara yakaenzana nenhamba yemapateni anozadza plane.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.d: Mubvunzo ndewekuti musanganiswa wega wega unozadza plane yose here. Hapana chikonzero chekuti nhamba yemisanganiswa nenhamba yemapateni zvienzane.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.explain: Makona pavertex imwe anowedzera kuita 360° imamiriro anodiwa, kwete akakwana. Zvichizivikanwa, pamusoro pe10 iri pamusoro, (3,12,12), (4,6,12), (4,8,8), ne (6,6,6) chete ndizvo zvinozadza plane yose nerudzi rumwe chete rwekurongwa kwemavertex, uye (5,5,10) haigoni kuzadza plane yose nokuti kuenderera kumavertex ari padhuze kunotungamira kukupokana.
